results.content:
Kestrix is an AI-powered platform that uses thermal drone imagery, machine learning, and computer vision to create 3D maps of building heat loss and generate retrofit plans. Positioning itself as the 'Google Maps of heat loss', Kestrix addresses a critical gap in building energy efficiency by reducing energy surveying and analysis time from 2-3 hours to under one minute of surveyor time.

Unlike traditional manual surveying methods, Kestrix's proprietary AI rapidly reconstructs and interprets thermal imagery in a non-invasive way. The platform has already secured partnerships with organisations including E.ON, Islington Council, and the National Trust, helping to build a valuable dataset that will enable surveying at city-scale.

# Kestrix wins Energy Startup Roadshow 2026

All newsEcosystem news

Written by Jake Fox

Kestrix, an AI platform that maps and quantifies building heat loss, has been announced as the winner of the Startup Roadshow Energy 2026. The event, the second in the Startup Roadshow 2026 series, brought together founders, investors, and key players from the energy sector. [...] Lucy Lyons (Kestrix CEO) says:

"We're thrilled to have won the Energy Startup Roadshow and grateful for the opportunity to share how Kestrix is tackling one of the built environment's biggest challenges. The event was a fantastic platform to connect with investors and fellow founders who are passionate about innovation in the energy space.."

Jake Fox (South East Angels) says:

"Lucy delivered a compelling pitch that showcased that her team both understood the problem deeply and had the skills to develop a scalable commercial model for growth. There is a huge amount of value in capturing heat loss data at scale as the country continues its journey towards net-zero.”
